RawRule.description: A rule: an `id` (`[a-z0-9_]{1,32}`), one or more conditions, and a verdict.

RawServer.description: A server, by IP (never resolved), as for upstreams (edge.md §6).

trust_store.description: PEM text (`dot`, `doh`); none: the Mozilla roots.

RawWhen.description: The conditions; all set ones must hold.

answers_in.description: The answer has A or AAAA records and every one is in these IPs or CIDRs.

cname_suffix.description: The answer's CNAME chain ends at a name under one of these suffixes.

ede.description: An EDE carries one of these INFO-CODEs; `"none"`: the answer has no EDE.

ede_text.description: An EDE's EXTRA-TEXT contains this text (ASCII case-insensitive).

rcode.description: The rcode is one of these.

soa.description: `true`: the authority section holds an SOA; `false`: it doesn't.

RuleVerdict.description: A rule's verdict: `block` (a Block whose reason is the rule's id), `clean` or `unknown`.

SelfTest.description: A self-test (providers.md §4 "Self-tests"): `cron` is UTC and parsed with `croner`.

config_schema.description: The config as stored and edited. The example is the `quad9` preset for DoT.

qtype.description: The query type, whatever the client asked.

rules.description: Checked in order; the first whose conditions all hold decides.

servers.description: Tried in order; a server that failed is skipped for 30 s while another works.

transport.description:
One transport per provider, so an encrypted provider never falls back to plain DNS:
`dot` (default; port 853), `doh` (443), `udp` (53; a truncated answer is retried over TCP)
or `tcp` (53).

x-picket-warning.text: Plain DNS is unencrypted. Every name this provider looks up is sent in clear text, and anyone on the network path can read it or change the answer, letting a blocked name through or blocking any name. Use DoT or DoH unless the resolver offers neither.

config_schema.title: RawConfig

Encrypted.description: The presets offer DoT and DoH only (plain DNS isn't offered).
The presets offer DoT and DoH only (plain DNS isn't offered).

self_test.description:
A name on the profile's denylist, checked hourly (catches the free plan's monthly limit,
past which NextDNS answers without filtering).

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the value compared, e.g. `/risk_score`.

config_schema.description: The config as stored and edited (the UI form comes from its schema).

headers.description: Request headers; values may reference secrets as `${secret:name}`.

url.description:
An `https://` URL with `{domain}` where the name goes, after the host (the name is
percent-encoded).

config_schema.title: RawConfig

limits: Only logged queries are checked: a profile with log: blocked or off sends core no allowed queries.
The ladder isn't replayed with the bundle added: a name response checks would still let through counts too, and sync lookups are approximated from the logged verdicts.
